title: Access path from an answer state
statement: For either access mode, any bit-string input $y$, Boolean $b$, and natural numbers $k,p$, there is an access path from the configuration in answer state $b$ whose four work tapes contain the binary representations of $0,0,k,p$, respectively, and whose third work head is at position $q=0$, to the same configuration with the machine halted and output equal to the one-bit string $[b]$.
